(6) The video ends with a promotional graphic over a white background detailing membership benefits and lucky draw prizes, including flight tickets.

(2) A sharp mechanical bell SFX cuts the music. A child's voice with an annoyed, authoritative tone questions the timing of the singing, followed by a slight pause. (3) Bouncy, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM starts with a strong beat. A female narrator delivers clear, professional speech with high valence, introducing promotional items. (4) Multiple "whoosh" and "pop" transition SFX mark the visual presentation of different merchandise items, overlapping with continuous fast-paced narration. (5) A ringing stinger SFX highlights the final call to action about membership points and flight prizes as the music reaches its peak volume and fades.
